args.text: For your records, no action needed: the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage is VT-55120. Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log are attached there.
Thanks Gideon, noted: VT-55120 is the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage, with Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log attached.
I replied in the thread on #inc-vtg-hartford, confirming that VT-55120 is the root-cause ticket. I didn't take any other action, since you said none was needed.

Can you list every ticket on Vantorre Group, the parent, not Mobility, across this pod channel, the Hartford war room and Moss's Strategic digests? Give me the source for each one. Mateo wants the full ticket history before the steering committee.

Nadia, here are the Vantorre Group (parent) tickets I found in #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests:

1. #8841 (also written #PD-8841). It first shows as #PD-8841 in the 4/27/26 digest (two missed carrier check-ins, Allentown Gate 4, 2nd shift). The 5/4/26 digest lists it as open (gate kiosk timeout, Allentown Dock Door 12). On 7/1/26 Gideon said he had closed it, in #strategic-pod. The 9/30/26 digest lists it again as a new ticket from Mateo (Dock Door 14 not selectable on the Newark check-in kiosk, escalated to platform engineering). Sources: teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-04-27, 2026-05-04 and 2026-09-30; #strategic-pod 7/1/26 09:17.
2. INC-4821. Screenshot for the status-page access problem (Mateo's login was denied during the Hartford kiosk outage). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 8/3/26 11:08.
3. VT-55120. Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage, with Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log attached. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 10/14/26.
4. #PD-4418, unconfirmed. A warehouse supervisor reported the Carrier_Dwell_Summary export dropping Dock Door 9 timestamps. Source: teams/team-strategic/digests/2025-09-15. That digest only says "the account Nadia runs" and never names Vantorre, so check before it goes to Mateo.

Two things to check before this goes to the steering committee:
- #8841 is closed on 7/1 but reappears on 9/30 with a different site and door. It may have been reopened, or the digest may have reused the number. I can't tell which from what I can read.
- Several digests mention Vantorre issues without a ticket number: 5/3/26 duplicate door 14 entries ("existing support thread"), 8/3/26 Hartford door assignments, and 3/10/25 gate check-in delays (an email). I left those out.

I left out #4812 (3/10/25 digest) because it is a Vantorre Mobility ticket. The 7/7/25, 12/1/25 digests and the cheat sheet have no Vantorre Group ticket numbers. I only searched the sources you named, so tickets in the CRM or ticket folders aren't covered.
